chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"Marry a free woman to a slave girl, and do not marry a slave girl to a free woman. And whoever marries a slave girl to a free woman, his marriage is invalid."
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on marrying a slave girl to a free woman in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the hierarchical structure of polygyny by prioritizing the status of the free woman (*al-hurrah*) over the slave girl (*al-amah*), ensuring the free wife retains her social and legal precedence. It establishes that while a man may have multiple slave girls, the specific act of 'marrying' a slave girl to a free woman (integrating her into the free woman's tier) is valid, whereas the reverse is not, rendering such a union invalid (*batil*). This ruling reflects the Shia juristic emphasis on maintaining the dignity and superior status of the free spouse within the household structure.
